__comment: Federated RAG federation observability. Colours follow the Acme Brand book §20 data-viz palette (fixed series order Saffron→Emerald→Navy→Teal→Gold→Solar). METRIC-NAME ASSUMPTION: the panels below query rag_audit_action_total{action="..."}, a counter derived from the AuditAction values grant_issue/grant_revoke/federated_query (see libs/schemas AuditAction). The EXACT metric name must match whatever the app exports via OTel→Prometheus — this dashboard cannot be verified against a live app here, so if the export uses a different name (e.g. a per-action metric or a different label key than `action`) update the exprs to match. See the 'Metric assumptions' text panel in-dashboard.
title: RAG as a Service — Federated RAG Federation

options.content:
These panels assume the app exports federation audit actions as a Prometheus counter **`rag_audit_action_total{action="grant_issue|grant_revoke|federated_query", src_dept="..."}`** (derived from `AuditAction`). If the OTel→Prometheus export uses a different metric or label name, edit the panel queries to match — this dashboard was authored without a running app to confirm the exact series.

**Federation health (T1):** `rag_audit_action_total{action="federation_denied"}` (peer refused a query) and `{action="federation_alert"}` (denial-burst anomaly). Federation SLO: **0** anomaly alerts/hour in steady state; investigate any denial-rate spike.

panels.title: Grants issued vs revoked
panels.description: Grant lifecycle events (AuditAction.GRANT_ISSUE / GRANT_REVOKE). Emerald = issued, Saffron = revoked.

panels.title: Active grants (issued − revoked)
panels.description: Net cumulative grants currently authorising cross-dept access. Approximated as total issued minus total revoked over the range; replace with a direct gauge (e.g. rag_active_grants) if the app exposes one.

panels.title: Cross-dept queries by source department
panels.description: Federated query rate broken down by the requesting (source) department.

panels.title: Grant-denied (no-grant skip) rate
panels.description: Share of federated-query peer attempts skipped because no active grant authorised the cross-dept read. Assumes a counter rag_federation_grant_denied_total; if the app instead tags skips as a federated_query label (e.g. outcome="no_grant") switch the numerator to that series.

panels.title: Federation denials (grant refused at use)
panels.description: Peers that REFUSED a federated query (grant revoked/invalid at use). A rising line for one source department is a grant-probing signal (T1).

panels.title: Federation anomaly alerts (denial burst)
panels.description: FEDERATION_ALERT events: a caller denied by many peers in one query (grant-probing). Non-zero warrants a look. SLO: 0 alerts/hour in steady state.
